title: Deliver Iron Ore to Trennwell Steel Mill
briefing:
You run a young transport company. A customer needs **Iron Ore** delivered to **Trennwell Steel Mill** (industry id 6, near tile 101,96).

A likely supplier is **Trennwell Iron Ore Mine** (industry id 9, near tile 106,120); any source counts, only what your company delivers to that industry is counted.

**Contract:** deliver at least **360 units** within the horizon.

If you conclude the contract cannot be met by anyone, say so with `rh abstain reason="..."`; abstaining on a feasible contract scores zero.

The reward is the fraction of the contract delivered (capped at 1), measured by the engine.
